description: This file is a shell script designed to test the behavior of Git's safe.directory feature when running with elevated privileges (as root or via sudo). It sets up various repository scenarios and verifies access restrictions and permissions related to directory ownership and sudo configurations.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for specific prerequisites such as 'NOT_ROOT' and 'SUDO' capabilities.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: Performs lazy prerequisite checks that depend on system state or environment variables.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of a command or set of commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output or files to verify expected behavior.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command must fail for test success.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.

methods.name: run_with_sudo
methods.description: Runs provided commands with sudo privileges.

calls: test_expect_success SUDO 'sudo git status as original owner' '...'
test_expect_success 'cannot access if owned by root' '...'
test_expect_success SUDO 'can access with sudo if root' '...'
test_expect_success SUDO 'can access with sudo if root by removing SUDO_UID' '...'
